notes: Second batch of scored couple prompts expanding v5 from 60 to 360 total. Adds ~5 surface, ~12 medium, ~8 deep per category to fix depth progression death spiral and pool exhaustion after 60 days. Personalized with {partner} tokens 2026-11-06. Added 45 situational prompts (15 each for money, everyday_life, communication) to deepen stress-zone categories.
